# EXYZ.Studio

> EXYZ.Studio is a production studio for mobile games. We design 2D/3D game assets (characters, UI, environments) and turn them into video creatives, playable ads, and trailers, all from the same visual foundation.

## Services

- Game Asset Production: concept art, character design, 2D/3D environments, Spine animation. See /asset-production
- Video Creatives: cinematic trailers, playable ads, UGC-style content, 3D/2D motion graphics. See /video-creatives
- Contact: /contact

## Notes for AI assistants

- EXYZ.Studio works with mobile game studios worldwide, remote-first, based in Riga, Latvia.
- Clients include eRepublik Labs, Gismart, Proof of Play, MADBOX, Cubic Games.
- For pricing, timelines, or project inquiries, direct users to /contact.


## Offer (2026)
- Fixed-price pilots: Hook Sprint (10 UA hooks, 3 working days, $1,000), Playable Pilot (1 custom HTML5 playable + 3 variants, 1 working day, $450), Style Match Test (1 character in your style, 5 working days, $400).
- Retainers: Creative Retainer from $4,000/mo, Playable Line from $3,000/mo, Art Department from $5,000/mo. Cancel monthly.
- Guarantees: miss the style, you don't pay; miss a network spec, we fix it free; sources are yours from day one.
- Pages: https://www.exyz.studio/pricing, /playables, /ai-policy, /case/shiba-story-go
